# GeeksforGeeks

> > A comprehensive computer science learning portal offering tutorials, courses, and interview preparation across programming languages (Java, C++, Python, JavaScript), data structures & algorithms, web development, machine learning, and system design.

GeeksforGeeks is one of the most popular educational platforms for computer science students and professionals, providing extensive resources for coding practice, technical interview preparation, and skill development across multiple programming domains.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- Java Programming
- C++ Programming
- Python Programming
- JavaScript
- C Programming
- Linux/Unix
- Interview Preparation
- Web Development
- Machine Learning
- System Design
- Programming Tutorials
- Online Courses
- Competitive Programming

## Main Portal

- [GeeksforGeeks | Your All-in-One Learning Portal](https://gdevtest.geeksforgeeks.org/): Homepage for GeeksforGeeks learning portal covering DSA, Java, C++, and more
